# Virunga Homestay

> A premium homestay experience at the foot of the Virunga Volcanoes in Musanze, Northern Rwanda. We offer comfortable rooms, authentic community activities, local cuisine, shop, car rentals, and curated travel content for guests seeking genuine cultural connection.

**Website:** https://virungahomestay.com  
**Location:** Musanze (Ruhengeri), Northern Rwanda  
**Contact:** +250 784 513 435  
**Booking:** Direct on WhatsApp or via the website contact form  
**Languages:** English

## Key Information

### Location & Getting There
Virunga Homestay is situated in Musanze (formerly Ruhengeri), the gateway city to Volcanoes National Park in Northern Rwanda. Musanze is approximately 2–2.5 hours by road from Kigali International Airport (KGL). The homestay can arrange airport transfers on request.

### What Makes Us Unique
- Family-run property with direct host interaction
- Walking distance from local markets and community cooperatives
- Immersive cooking classes using fresh, locally sourced Rwandan ingredients
- Cultural storytelling evenings and imigongo craft sessions
- Proximity to gorilla trekking, golden monkey tracking, and volcano hikes
- Eco-conscious approach supporting local artisans and farmers

### Nearby Attractions
- **Volcanoes National Park** — Mountain gorilla and golden monkey trekking (permit required)
- **Twin Lakes (Burera & Ruhondo)** — Scenic lakeside cycling and kayaking
- **Dian Fossey Gorilla Fund campus** — Research and conservation centre
- **Musanze Caves** — Underground river cave system
- **Lake Kivu (2 hrs)** — Beach, boat trips, and lakeside towns Gisenyi/Rubavu

### Room Types
The homestay offers a range of rooms for solo travellers, couples, and families. All rooms include clean bedding, mosquito nets, a fan or AC, access to shared or en-suite bathrooms, Wi-Fi, and breakfast. Exact availability and pricing are listed on the Rooms page and confirmed via WhatsApp.

### Booking Process
1. Browse rooms or activities on the website
2. Click **Book on WhatsApp** or **Contact Us**
3. Send your preferred dates, number of guests, and room type
4. Receive a confirmation and payment instructions within 24 hours

### Activities Overview
| Activity | Duration | Group Size |
|---|---|---|
| Rwandan Cooking Class | 3–4 hours | 2–8 guests |
| Cultural Village Walk | Half day | 1–10 guests |
| Imigongo Art Workshop | 2–3 hours | 2–8 guests |
| Farm & Coffee Tour | 4–6 hours | 2–10 guests |
| Birdwatching Walk | Flexible | 1–6 guests |
| Sunrise Volcano Viewpoint | Half day | 1–6 guests |
